author: evorthon-data maintainer
content: Hand authored identities, digests and notes with invented names and values. No real, personal or confidential data, and no record taken from any system.

files.candidate.json: The candidate artefact the fixture runner declares, as identity, version and declared digest.
files.declared-outputs/conformance-case/v1.jso: The outputs the fixture runner replays for one frozen case, with the case digest they were frozen against.
The stored bytes of an invented checkpoint note.
What the environment declares about those bytes: digest, validity and summary.
files.evidence/conformance-lineage-note/v1.con: The stored bytes of an invented lineage note.
files.evidence/conformance-lineage-note/v1.rec: What the environment declares about those bytes: digest, validity and summary.

purpose: The material the fixture evidence repository and fixture candidate runner read, so the reference adapters run the conformance suite and a real intake with no environment of any kind.
source: Identities, digests and notes written by hand for the reference adapters, emitted by the shipped fixture writer and committed as the material it produced.
